mqtt.title: MyQ MQTT relay client
mqtt.description: This is only an MQTT client for an already-running device-facing relay. For local MyQ opener control, Home Assistant recommends ratgdo. Use the official myQ app for provider remote control.

cloud.title: myQ application OAuth
cloud.description: Experimental app API access. The provider may require a client secret for this client ID. Enter credentials belonging to an OAuth client you can use. Sign in with your username/password on the provider page in the next step.

callback.title: Complete provider sign-in
callback.description: [Continue with myQ]({auth_url}). Use your provider login, including Amazon if offered. Copy the full final callback URL here, including code and state. The app callback may need to be copied from browser developer tools. Amazon Key account linking is a separate delivery feature. If the provider requires a client secret, enable advanced setup.

login.title: Sign in to myQ
login.description: Sign in to discover garage doors automatically. If the provider needs browser verification or a different login method, setup will offer its sign-in page. Your password is used for this attempt and is not saved.

error.invalid_opener_id: Enter a ten-character hexadecimal serial and six-byte hexadecimal opener ID
error.cloud_auth_failed: Provider sign-in or account discovery failed. The API may require client credentials or block third-party access. Start a fresh sign-in before submitting another code.
error.no_devices: No supported garage door openers found on this account.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same account as this integration entry.
abort.already_configured: This account or device is already configured.
